Why Painters Inner West

Local, licensed and genuinely accountable

We’re not a franchise or a lead-gen middleman. Painters Inner West is owner-operated by Bobby Nojad, licensed (315254C) and insured, with more than 20 years across Sydney’s Inner West. When you call, you deal with the person who does the work.

  • Fixed-price quotes after an on-site look — no call-out fee
  • Premium Australian paint systems, matched to your surfaces
  • Tidy, respectful crews and a clean site every day
  • Deep local knowledge of Inner West homes and buildings
